verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Balance product for real-time balance information, explicitly intended to check that an account has sufficient funds before it is used to fund a payment. That matches the NSF/risk-check use case directly, and the Sandbox supports all API functionality for testing it. Missing for 10: the specific endpoint name and request/response details are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliable the real-time balance is.
